newsitem.title: ITALY: ENI signs co-op accord with Croatia's INA.
newsitem.headline: ENI signs co-op accord with Croatia's INA.

text.p: Italy's energy giant ENI has signed an accord with Croatia's state-owned oil and gas company INA for increased co-operation between the two companies that already exists within Croatia.
A statement from ENI on Thursday said that the accord was signed at the Offshore Mediterranean Conference on Wednesday between ENI chairman Guglielmo Moscato and INA chairman Andrija Kojakovic.
Co-operation in Croatia has existed between ENI's production and exploration arm Agip and INA since the late 1970's, which led to an accord to develop off-share gas in Croatia last year.

The new accord which covers the exploration of a new off-shore area off the city of Zara of around 2,500 square kilometres. Agip expects the cost of exploration over five years to be around $25 million.
